Basic chat completion request routed through the proxy

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Say hello" } } as Message], model: "openai/gpt-4o" });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
}

void main();
```
